transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, what finally scared me into coming in is that... after I eat too much, I’ve been making myself throw up in the bathroom. I just do it so I won’t gain weight. But it’s gotten to where it isn’t just a one-time mistake anymore, and that really frightened me into making an appointment.
During these episodes where you feel you have eaten too much, do you feel like you lose control over your eating and consume an amount of food that most people would consider unusually large?

Yes, I do. Once I start, it just feels like I can't stop. It usually happens after a bridge night, or sometimes after a late shift at the store. I'll come home and... well, I might eat some leftover casserole, the cookies I baked, crackers, ice cream... just all of it in one sitting. It is definitely much more than I’d ever put on a plate in front of anyone else.
Aside from making yourself vomit, do you engage in any other methods to prevent weight gain after these episodes, such as excessive exercising or using laxatives?

No, I don't do anything like that. I'm on my feet a lot at the store, so I definitely don't have the energy to do any extra exercising. And I've never taken laxatives or anything. It's really just the... well, just making myself throw up.
Over the past three months, how often have these episodes of eating a large amount of food and then making yourself vomit typically occurred?

Well, for at least the past several months, it’s... it's been happening most weeks. I'll have one of those secret eating spells, and then I go make myself sick afterward. I really can’t honestly call it occasional anymore.
How much does your body weight or your shape influence how you feel about yourself as a person?

It affects me a lot, honestly. Like, if my skirt feels tight before church, or if I catch my side view in the store mirror, it can just ruin my whole day. I start feeling like everyone can tell I’ve let myself go, and it's hard to think about anything else. My weight pretty much dictates how I feel about myself.
Could you tell me your current height and weight so I can get a better sense of your overall physical health?

I'm about five foot four, I think. As for my weight... I haven't actually stepped on a scale in a little while. I just know my clothes are fitting differently, but I couldn't give you an exact number right now.
Could you give me a rough estimate of your current weight so I can better understand your physical health?

I honestly don't know. I mean, I really try to avoid the scale because it just makes me feel worse. If I had to guess, maybe around 140 or 150 pounds? But like I said, I haven't checked, so I can't be sure.
To be clear, have these episodes of eating a large amount of food and then making yourself vomit been happening at least once every single week for the past three months?

Yes, that's right. For at least the past several months, it’s been happening most weeks... I'll have one of those secret eating spells and then go make myself sick afterward. I can’t honestly call it occasional anymore. It's definitely been at least once a week.
